title: The Ashen Compact
summary: A demanding Shadow Knight helmet campaign in Kael · Live testing.
body:
Live testing

The campaign is installed for live testing. Close EverQuest and use launcher Play to install the paired helmet appearance. Full-route gameplay, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

A warlord’s challenge

At level 50, with Shadow Knight in any held class slot, speak to Drazhul Blackmantle in the hidden Everfrost passage before Permafrost. Accept the Compact to seal your pledge, then use the adjacent Kael Keeper to cross the ice giants’ frostbound passage. The return brings you back to this Everfrost passage. Difficulty is intended for a developed Shadow Knight main; reaching level 50 alone does not establish readiness.

The stolen war-fire

A renegade war cult in Rallos Zek’s giant city binds stolen souls into its standards. Break its claim and temper its war-fire into your own helm. These characters and events are original Nightcap fiction; you do not kill Rallos Zek or the original Avatar of War.

Fourteen duties

  1. Enter your Ashen Compact expedition
  2. Defeat the Herald of the Iron Oath
  3. Claim the Standard of Conquest
  4. Claim the Standard of Dread
  5. Claim the Standard of Dominion
  6. Protect Veyra's binding through three waves
  7. Defeat Marshal Kharzug
  8. Claim the oath of the Knight of Hunger
  9. Claim the oath of the Knight of Ruin
  10. Claim the oath of the Knight of Defiance
  11. Defeat General Vhalek
  12. Defeat the Echo of Endless War
  13. Temper the Warhelm at the War Altar
  14. Return to Drazhul and claim your helm

Survive the Compact

The Herald warns before his warcry: interrupt or leave its radius. Protect Veyra and control three waves. Kharzug summons two owned war souls at half health. Vhalek and the Echo mark your position with three seconds to move more than ten paces or interrupt. Named champions resist charm and fear; their war souls remain controllable. The final Echo can flurry. Full route and build-specific balance still require player testing.

Keep your progress

Be alive, enrolled and nearby for personal boss credit. Pet kills credit eligible owners. Completed duties survive reconnects and run resets; removing the Tasks display does not erase them. Make room for both story and dungeon journals. Return to Drazhul after tempering the helm. A full inventory leaves delivery pending; a durable receipt prevents duplicate claims.

The Warhelm

Warhelm of the Ashen Compact is a one-time custom reward based on the Warhelm of Rallos Zek appearance. Camil’s item remains separate. Browse all fourteen Kael rewards. The enclosed Classic model package is published; native rendering and animation acceptance remain pending.
